verdict.rationale: Cursor's cloud/background agents ('launch fleets of agents', 'always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers', 'runs in your terminal, collaborates in Slack, and reviews PRs in GitHub') imply tasks can be started and monitored from multiple surfaces, and a support-bot claim of a 'single-device login policy' was explicitly denied by Cursor staff, suggesting no cross-device restriction. However, there is no direct evidence of a seamless session hand-off (e.g., starting an interactive coding task on desktop and resuming in a browser), so this is inferred rather than confirmed.
